item.title: Join the 8th annual Texas Pie Fest in Rockwall this April
item.description: The eighth annual Texas Pie Fest will be held on April 18 at Summerfield at Tate Farms in Rockwall, featuring pie tastings, an artisan market, and pie baking and eating contests with celebrity judges.

item.title: Texas cities lead list of top 25 dangerous places for drivers
item.description: A new study projects Dallas to be among the top 25 deadliest cities in the US for traffic fatalities in 2026, with Memphis, Knoxville and Detroit leading the projections.

item.title: North Texas businesses offer themed deals for 214 day
item.description: Dallas residents will celebrate 214 Day on Feb. 14 with themed deals on food and entertainment from several North Texas businesses, including breakfast specials, family pizza packages, and large chicken meals.

item.title: Craftsman hosts $20K Instagram giveaway on Championship Sunday
item.description: CRAFTSMAN is launching a $20,000 giveaway on Instagram during Championship Sunday on Feb. 8, 2026, allowing football fans to win V20 cordless power tools and retailer gift cards in a gamified event.

item.title: Wendy's offers $1 Dave's Single for Singles Awareness Day
item.description: Wendy's is offering a Dave's Single cheeseburger for $1 on Singles Awareness Day, February 15, when purchased through the Wendy's app or website.

item.title: Yankee Candle bestsellers are up to 40% off for Valentine’s Day
item.description: Right now, some of the brand’s most popular large jar candles are marked down up to 40%, just in time for Valentine's Day.

item.title: Frisco unveils Frankie, AI guide for FIFA World Cup 2026 fans
item.description: Visit Frisco has launched Frankie, an AI-powered assistant to help travelers plan trips and navigate the city ahead of the FIFA World Cup 26, providing real-time recommendations for hotels, restaurants, and events.

item.title: Texans are rooting for the Seattle Seahawks: Study
item.description: The Seattle Seahawks are the national favorite for Super Bowl LX, with support from residents in 35 states, including Texas, while the New England Patriots only have support from 10 states.

item.title: Blue Jacket Fashion Show celebrates 10 years of prostate cancer advocacy
item.description: The Blue Jacket Fashion Show is celebrating its 10th anniversary of raising awareness for prostate cancer while blending fashion, entertainment, sports, healthcare, and media.

item.title: Lego finally unveils 3 Pokémon sets — and one is wildly expensive
item.description: LEGO just unveiled its first-ever Pokémon building sets, and they’re already available for preorder.
